# TODO 1.2.0

## 新增
- 新增：行内草稿行，可在侧栏直接创建根任务与子任务，并一并设置截止日期与时间
- 新增：日历选日 + 可选时间面板，写入 Tasks 兼容的 `📅 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`
- 新增：勾选动效（对勾描边、删除线、标签弱化），可在设置中关闭
- 新增：勾选父任务后自动折叠子任务（可选，需开启动效）

## 优化
- 优化：嵌套引导线改为 L 形虚线通道，默认开启
- 优化：日期时间控件改为扁平胶囊样式，与侧栏极简外观一致
- 优化：新建子任务在父任务下就地展开输入，不必再走弹窗

## 调整
- 调整：嵌套引导线默认由关闭改为开启

# TODO 1.2.0

## Added
- Added: inline draft row to create root tasks and subtasks with optional due date and time
- Added: calendar date picker with optional time, writing Tasks-compatible `📅 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`
- Added: check-off motion (stroke, strike-through, chip fade), toggleable in settings
- Added: optional auto-collapse of children after checking a parent (requires motion)

## Improved
- Improved: nest guides redrawn as L-shaped dashed channels; on by default
- Improved: flat capsule date/time control aligned with the minimal sidebar look
- Improved: subtask creation expands an inline input under the parent instead of a modal

## Changed
- Changed: nest guide lines default from off to on
